title: Kitty Tiptoes | Sneaky Kitten Kids Song & Nursery Rhymes | BuBu TV - English
description:
A sleepy kitten sneaks into the kitchen on tiptoe, but a crash wakes everyone up!
This fun song teaches kids to say sorry and to always ask before taking something.
Sing along with the tiptoe chorus and learn about being quiet, kind, and polite.

Tiptoe, tiptoe, shh, shh, shh
Sweet little kitty
Tiptoe, tiptoe, tiptoe, tiptoe
Nobody hears a peep!

Everyone is sleeping, shh, shh, shh
The kitty goes tip, tip, tip
Creep, creep, creep, to the kitchen door
Quiet as a little mouse!

Grabs the fish, the kitty grabs it
"Mew, mew," it purrs with glee
Crash! Bang! Boom! A pot falls down
Oh no, the kitty's caught!

Everyone wakes up, "Who's there?"
The kitten says, "Meow, sorry!"
Sorry, sorry, sorry, sorry
Let's make it up together!

Amma gives the kitten milk
"Ask first, don't take," she says
Milk, milk, milk, yum, yum
Good kitty, now, goodnight!
